[sudo Syntax] How do you configure a specific user or group in `/etc/sudoers` to run a specific command (e.g., `/usr/bin/apt update`) without prompting for a password?
column2: Add the `NOPASSWD:` directive before the command path (e.g., `username ALL=(ALL:ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/apt update`).
